title: Radial Solutions of Multi-Field de Sitter Galileons
summary: We study static, spherically symmetric screening solutions in the $\mathfrak{so}(N)$-invariant multi-field de Sitter Galileon theory, with matter couplings preserving the internal symmetry. Unlike in flat space, the de Sitter radial problem is affected both by the cosmological horizon and by the possible appearance of a finite strong-coupling radius, where the radial equation becomes singular and the effective description breaks down.
